source_qualified_identities.source_text: HELIXを使う開発者・workerが意味入力に集中し、同じPLAN/PR定型欄や派生物を繰り返し手修正せず既存検証へ渡す。対象は既存Authoring利用者とCI/Cursor先行経路。新しい業務設計・思考順序は固定しない。

condition_comparison.source_condition: Actor and purpose: developers/workers retain attention for meaning input; generated repeated-form fields and derived artifacts are usable by existing validation.

legacy_consumer_refs.condition: BBG-R01 keeps semantic input separate from derived and observed fields and forbids fixing undefined business logic/design in templates.
AC01 preserves unsupported business design as meaning input; AC06 measures the full consumer flow.

condition_comparison.retained_or_rederived: HARNESS-003/005 preserve process gates and derive verification obligations/evidence. INTELLIGENCE-015 detects repeated reproducible failure patterns; 016 bounds repair candidates; 017 keeps permission, Worker, HARNESS, and OS results distinct. These are adjacent controls for failure detection/repair and workflow evidence.
condition_comparison.residual: The selected pairs do not define PLAN/PR form fields, derived artifact output, an Authoring/CI/Cursor consumer contract, or a BR01-specific reduction in repeated hand edits. INTELLIGENCE repair is limited to repairable failure patterns and does not generate ordinary forms or new business design.

condition_comparison.source_condition: The target remains an existing Authoring user and the named CI/Cursor-first path; new business design or thought order is not fixed by generation.

legacy_consumer_refs.condition: L12 recognition requires a fixed existing Authoring/CI/Cursor path and rejects scope or comparison mismatch and newly fixed work order.
The approved migration preserves the BR→R→AC trace and does not add meanings or identities.

condition_comparison.retained_or_rederived: Pair/lifecycle boundaries and bounded repair/evidence conditions remain adjacent process controls.
condition_comparison.residual: No fixed pair names the legacy consumer path or supplies a BR-specific consumer-use result. The no-new-business-design boundary is not equivalent to defining all supported authoring inputs.

condition_comparison.source_condition: Repeated hand edits are reduced and useful work reaches existing validation; output generation alone is insufficient.

legacy_consumer_refs.condition: AC06 fixes target version/input/HEAD, compares the named efficiency and quality measures under equal conditions, and forbids claims with unset thresholds, mismatched conditions, or small samples.
L12 rejects output-only, unused generation, labor shifted elsewhere, unconfigured thresholds/sample, and treats uncollected or mismatched results as unrecognized.

condition_comparison.retained_or_rederived: HARNESS-003/005 keep verification and stage completion distinct. INTELLIGENCE-015/016/017 address repeated failure detection, limited repair, and cross-owner evidence handoff.
condition_comparison.residual: None of these pairs supplies the existing-consumer before/after oracle or measured efficiency result. AC06 leaves threshold, sample count, and consumer to the existing NFR and requires them before measurement; no numeric value is stated in BR01 itself.

condition_comparison.source_condition: BBG-R02 deterministic generation: typed input is validated as untrusted; same source, input, and generator version yield the same semantic output; execution time is separated into observation; free text/external documents are not executable code.

legacy_consumer_refs.condition: R02 stable error codes for missing, contradictory, or unsupported input; deterministic semantic output for the same source/input/generator version; runtime values such as time are separate; free text/external documents are not executed.
AC02 maps to R02 and checks semantic-output equality, time separation, stable rejection codes, and non-execution of external strings.

fixed_pair_condition_comparison.condition: Process start/freeze/return/restart/completion gates, paired artifacts, verification, and unresolved items; execution success alone does not complete a stage.
fixed_pair_condition_comparison.relation: adjacent_process_boundary; no deterministic generator semantic-output contract.

fixed_pair_condition_comparison.condition: Derives verification duties and evidence conditions from ticket/relation/change properties.
fixed_pair_condition_comparison.relation: adjacent_verification_obligation; no same-source/input/generator-version output equality or stable generation error-code oracle.

fixed_pair_condition_comparison.condition: Detects reproducible repeated failure patterns, bounds repair scope, and separates permission/Worker/HARNESS/OS results.
fixed_pair_condition_comparison.relation: adjacent_detection_and_repair; these clauses do not establish general typed form generation, deterministic semantic output, or external-text non-execution.

condition_comparison.retained_or_rederived: The fixed pairs retain stage/verification boundaries, bounded failure repair, and distinct owner results. They cover controls around work and repair, not BBG-R02 generation behavior.
condition_comparison.residual: No selected fixed pair states an oracle for same-source/input/generator-version semantic equality, stable R02 input error codes, runtime-time separation, or external-text non-execution. Those remain legacy comparison conditions, not proven current behavior.

condition_comparison.source_condition: Existing consumer/implementation seam: the BBG core reuses GH-FR-007 CLI generation plus ledger reconciliation, GH-FR-014 template/schema/fixture-first, and #1608 source→generator→output→consumer propagation; semantic input, canonical derived fields, and trusted execution-receipt citations remain separate. BBG-R02 passes typed input to the existing CLI and treats AI JSON as untrusted input. Skill/Rule/bounded-repair acceptance remains separate, with no separate Compiler, DB, or Policy source.

legacy_consumer_refs.condition: R02 responsibility/reuse text names GH-FR-007 CLI generation and ledger reconciliation, GH-FR-014 template/schema/fixture-first, #1608 source→generator→output→consumer propagation, separate semantic/derived/receipt-citation fields, and no separate Compiler/DB/Policy source.
R02 passes typed input to the existing CLI, validates AI JSON as untrusted input, and returns stable errors for missing, contradictory, or unsupported input.

fixed_pair_condition_comparison.condition: The fixed pairs define process gates and change-derived verification/evidence duties.
fixed_pair_condition_comparison.relation: adjacent_process_and_verification_controls; they do not specify GH-FR-007 CLI generation/ledger reconciliation, GH-FR-014 template/schema/fixture-first, #1608 source-to-consumer propagation, or typed input passed to an existing CLI.

fixed_pair_condition_comparison.condition: The fixed pairs define repeated-failure detection, bounded repair, and separate permission/Worker/HARNESS/OS results.
fixed_pair_condition_comparison.relation: adjacent_detection_repair_and_handoff_controls; they do not specify the named GH-FR-007/014 or #1608 consumer/implementation path, ledger reconciliation, or an existing-CLI typed-input boundary.

condition_comparison.comparison_limit: This is a bounded condition comparison against specified fixed pairs. It neither executes nor recommends executing the legacy CLI and does not assign a successor, establish equivalence, adopt source conditions, or change authority.

condition_comparison.source_condition: BBG-R04 update/retirement: bind source, generator, output, and consumer versions/digests to the existing projection; regenerate only affected areas; preserve meaning inputs in mixed documents; review semantic-digest changes; retire hand entry only after successor consumer verification and rollback.

legacy_consumer_refs.condition: R04 binds version/digest across source/generator/output/consumer, scopes regeneration to affected areas, protects meaning in mixed documents, and forbids unreviewed semantic digest refresh.
AC05 checks affected-only regeneration, mixed-document meaning preservation, reviewed semantic digest, and consumer verification plus rollback before retirement.

fixed_pair_condition_comparison.condition: Stage transitions require explicit agreement, paired artifacts, verification, and unresolved-item state; completed execution does not imply acceptance.
fixed_pair_condition_comparison.relation: adjacent_transition_control; no affected-only projection regeneration, mixed-document preservation, or consumer migration/rollback.

fixed_pair_condition_comparison.condition: Derives verification obligations/evidence by affected relation and records omitted checks for later recovery.
fixed_pair_condition_comparison.relation: adjacent_change-impact_and_verification; does not bind the four R04 versions/digests or define retirement conditions.

fixed_pair_condition_comparison.condition: Detects reproducible failure patterns, bounds repair write-set/side effects, and preserves distinct downstream owner results.
fixed_pair_condition_comparison.relation: adjacent_repair_and_handoff; not a source-to-consumer migration contract and not semantic-digest review/rollback.

condition_comparison.retained_or_rederived: The fixed pairs retain scoped impact/verification duties, stage separation, bounded repair, and distinct handoff results.
condition_comparison.residual: No selected fixed pair requires affected-only regeneration, preserves mixed-document semantic input during regeneration, binds source/generator/output/consumer versions and digests, or requires consumer verification and rollback before retiring a hand entry. The old R04/AC05 conditions therefore remain uncovered by these fixed pairs.

legacy_consumer_refs.condition: BBG-R03 derives authority facts from valid records and bounds observed path to real diff and allowed path to pre-existing scope.
AC03 rejects fabricated approvals/verdicts and diff/scope violations, including scope expansion.

condition_comparison.source_condition: Evidence and independent review remain authentic; a generated claim must not stand in for actual execution, review, verification, or acceptance.

legacy_consumer_refs.condition: Free-input approval/verdict/model/CI/cost/signature is forbidden; even empty stdout is separated from trusted receipt authenticity; independent oracle rejects fake receipt and generation-only pass.
AC04 accepts trusted exit-0 with empty stdout only with valid receipt semantics and rejects missing receipt/digest mismatch/handwritten success; source placement is not acceptance.
BR-level safety recognition uses AC03/04/05 plus actual independent review and completion evidence; L10 success does not imply L12 success.

condition_comparison.retained_or_rederived: HARNESS distinguishes workflow status, verification obligation, and acceptance. OS-018 keeps Worker assignment/execution within scope and authority; OS-019 persists source revision, actors, events, evidence, checkpoint and failed/unfinished continuity; SECURITY-008 governs each operation separately.
condition_comparison.residual: OS evidence/continuity and operation permission do not by themselves prove independent review identity/context or field-level authenticity of generated evidence. SECURITY permission does not create review or acceptance evidence. A BR02 consumer acceptance result is absent.

condition_comparison.residual: These are cross-mechanism contracts rather than the BBG-R03/R04 generation/consumer oracle. They do not establish an end-to-end non-escalation result or source retirement/rollback.
